objective: Read under a frozen contract the row-linear separated spaces of bit PHP and bit LeftPigeon with n = 2, 4, 8 holes, k = 1, 2, against Braun's separation range.
status: Closed: supported 2026-11-10 (exploratory, exact; frozen contract pre-registered in f7ea4ba2b): bit LeftPigeon's row-linear spaces over all rows stay separated at least as far as bit PHP's (horizons 2, 3, >=4 against none, 2, 4 for k = 1 at n = 2, 4, 8; 3 and >=4 for k = 2), and the horizon grows from n = 4 to 8: density that grows by the frozen rule, read from the contract's definition after a disclosed bug in run.py's horizon for degree-2 sets.
title: Row-linear separation on small instances
